$comment: Canonical migration policy. Enforced by scripts/migration-safety-check.ts, which runs in CI and in scripts/db-test.sh. Edit this file deliberately: every entry is an owner-level decision, not a convenience.

parked.reason: Blueprint Engine Phase 1 (26 tables, 33 functions). Parked by owner decision F, Phase 0C: not applied to hosted production and the product does not depend on it. Physically outside supabase/migrations so no db push, CLI or replay can reach it. Its one load-bearing object, public.assessment_run_reports, was extracted to 20260720180001_assessment_run_reports_canonical_home.sql.

neverReplay.reason: Owner decision I, Phase 0C. Re-executing this file would restore the broken global ranking guard, can strip security_invoker from the stored-report view, and would create a candidate-data exposure. It is already recorded in the hosted ledger, so supabase db push will not re-run it; the residual risk is a manual psql -f or a hand-written repair. It STAYS in the active path because later migrations correct it in sequence and a linear replay needs it.

approvedDuplicateVersions.reason: Both versions are already recorded in hosted production. Consolidating an already-applied pair is a separate owner-reviewed history operation, not a repository repair. Retained deliberately.

hostedLedgerOverrides.reason: Security Passport Phase 10 is recorded in hosted production as 20260818090001, not 20260818090000. The repository file was renamed to match hosted truth; hosted 20260818090000 is scp_closed_test_governance. This is the resolution of the only version collision in the repository.
hostedLedgerOverrides.verifyBeforeMerge: SELECT version, name FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations WHERE version IN ('20260818090000','20260818090001');
